title: A write on m1, read back on m3
note: The read is served by a member that never saw the client's put. It answers from the entry the leader replicated to it, and its header carries the cluster's revision rather than a count of the writes this member handled.

title: A write through a follower
note: A follower does not apply the write itself. It forwards the request to the leader and answers when the leader's entry is committed, which is why the revision in the answer is one the whole cluster agrees on. A member that applied the write locally would pass this one read and fail the moment another member wrote the same key.
